generation.scope: All five central quartics lift over the unrestricted fifteen-dimensional component. At the rational full-rank sample every degree-four derivation vanishing on the vertex idempotents is inner plus a central Euler multiple. A regular central element kills its own commutator obstruction. On one open neighborhood every geometric fiber is standard Koszul AS and each starting ideal is free of rank 256 over four central parameters. Every standard AS specialization on the closure satisfies a common polynomial identity.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed exact differentiation on the folded algebra, regular Euler multiples, the self-commutator obstruction, flat Artinian deformations, faithful completion, and a single Zariski-open all-degree central certificate.

mathematical_computation.scope: Four 224-column degree-four Leibniz systems on the rational path bases reduced at 1009 have ranks 188,184,192,192. Inner derivations and independent central Euler multiples give the matching lower bounds.

open_mathematics: Compute the full center and its quartic relation and generic central-simple degree on the fifteen-dimensional component. Determine which boundary points retain a central-parameter certificate, and address positive-dimensional edges.
